files.README.md:
# Orchardline analytics service

Reporting service for the Orchardline retail group.

- service/ - application code and dependency pins
- Builds run on a host without internet access; packages come from the internal mirror.

Library release histories are published on each project's own site.
files.service/figures.py:
from kestrelplot import Chart


def monthly_chart(series: dict[str, float]) -> Chart:
    """Render the twelve-month revenue series."""
    chart = Chart(title="Revenue by month")
    chart.add_series(series)
    return chart
